units: Targ. Y. II, Num. XXXII, 1 (h. text מקנה) herds.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Joshua 22:8">Targ. Josh. XXII, 8</cite> (h. text <cite ref="N00841"><he>נכסים</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 8:17">Targ. Deut. VIII, 17</cite> (h. text <he>הַיִל</he>); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 93a:2">B. Kam. 93ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>בתר מרא נ׳ וכ׳</he> behind a man of wealth chips are dragged along, i.e. in the company of a wealthy man you have an opportunity of making money.

<cite ref="Bekhorot 48a:7">Bekh. 48ᵃ</cite> <he>הא אשתעבד נ׳</he> Rashi (read: <he>אשתעבוד</he>; ed. <he>אשתעבדן להו לנ׳</he>) has not the estate been made responsible for the debt (before the father’s death)? <cite ref="Bekhorot 48a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>מכדי נ׳ דבר וכ׳</he> does not a person’s property merely take the place of a guarantor? <cite ref="Bava Batra 58a:10">B. Bath. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>כל נִכְסַי לחד ברא</he> all my property shall go to one son (of mine).
<cite ref="Bava Batra 58a:11">Ib.</cite> <he>כולהו נִכְסֵי דהאי</he> all the property (of the father) goes to this (son).
